name: SpaceMouse Compact

sources.title: 3Dconnexion SpaceMouse Compact product page (Technical Specifications)
sources.covers: the six-degrees-of-freedom sensor, buttons, dimensions, weight

note: A 6-DoF controller cap ("3Dconnexion® six-degrees-of-freedom (6Dof) sensor"; "push, pull, twist or tilt"), 2 programmable buttons. Dimensions "Length: 77 mm / 3” | Width: 77 mm / 3” | Height: 54 mm" (size_mm as stated: length, width, height), "Weight: 480 g". The cap's travel and the sample rate are not stated, so its bounds in the teleop study stay "not stated" until a measured box is entered; the connection is not given in the specifications read.

workspace.quote: Not stated: the cap's travel is not given.
